Market today: The midterms delivered a Democratic sweep, which is shaking up oil and potentially rewriting the playbook for Iran. This political shift is the main driver, and it's hitting your concentrated tech/chip book hard.

Your holdings: SMCI (-32.54%), MU (-48.29%), and SOXL (-70.33%) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on how the market digests the election results, especially any policy shifts impacting tech and energy.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your most significant losses and protecting your capital.
plays: Trim SMCI: Down 32.54%, stop at 37.3. Consider reducing exposure if it breaks below current levels.
Trim MU: Down 48.29%, stop at 31.6. This leveraged ETF is decaying badly; consider cutting losses.
Trim SOXL: Down 70.33%, stop at 200. This is a major loss; evaluate if the risk/reward justifies holding on margin.
